verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a Python agent framework that runs inside your own code: the docs say an agent can run behind a web frontend, in the terminal, on a background queue, or as a plain object you call run() on (docs-25), and the clai CLI can spin up a local uvicorn server for browser chat (docs-39). Hosted pieces are optional add-ons: Logfire telemetry is explicitly optional (docs-31), and any OpenAI-compatible provider can be used (docs-34), so the core does not depend on a vendor-hosted service. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license or installation/self-deployment docs, an explicit statement that no vendor-hosted component is required, and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments.
